dashboard.quickActions: Select an option from the sidebar to get started.

pendingInvitations.title: Pending invitations
pendingInvitations.description: You've been invited to join the following organizations.

invite.title: Invite Member
invite.subtitle: Invite a new member to your organization

legal.title: Legal Policies
legal.subtitle: Please read our legal documents carefully. By using our services, you agree to the terms outlined in these documents.
legal.agreementsDescription: Documents you have accepted. Click to view the version you signed.
legal.noTermsPublished: No terms and conditions have been published yet.
legal.noPrivacyPublished: No privacy policy has been published yet.

notReady.title: Almost There
notReady.subtitle: Your account has unmet requirements. Please complete setup on the web app.

widget.title: What can you do?
widget.description: Tasks you can start right now, or by switching to another organization you belong to.
widget.emptyDescription: Once you join an organization or are granted permissions, available tasks will appear here.

invite-member-company.title: Invite a member to a company
invite-member-company.description: Send an invitation by email or phone.
invite-member-company.step1: Open the company from the Organizations list
invite-member-company.step2: Switch to the Members List tab
invite-member-company.step3: Click "Invite Member" and enter the recipient's email or phone

invite-member-ops-center.title: Invite a member to an ops center
invite-member-ops-center.description: Add operators or managers to your ops center.
invite-member-ops-center.step1: Open the ops center from the Organizations list
invite-member-ops-center.step2: Switch to the Members List tab

invite-platform-admin.title: Invite a platform administrator
invite-platform-admin.description: Add a new admin to the platform org.
invite-platform-admin.step2: Switch to the Members List tab

edit-member-roles.title: Edit a member's roles
edit-member-roles.description: Promote, demote, or change a teammate's role.
edit-member-roles.step2: Switch to the Members List tab
edit-member-roles.step3: Click the edit icon next to the member

remove-member.title: Remove a member
remove-member.step2: Switch to the Members List tab
remove-member.step3: Open the member's record and choose "Remove Member"

create-organization.title: Create a new organization
create-organization.description: Spin up an ops center or company.
create-organization.step3: Pick the type and fill in the details

edit-organization.title: Edit your organization's details
edit-organization.description: Update name, logo, or contact info.
edit-organization.step2: Switch to the Organization Info tab

delete-organization.title: Delete an organization
delete-organization.description: Permanently remove an org you administer.
delete-organization.step2: Switch to the Organization Info tab
delete-organization.step3: Scroll to the danger zone and confirm "Delete"

manage-legal-documents.title: Manage legal documents
manage-legal-documents.description: Publish or update terms, privacy policy, and consent docs.
manage-legal-documents.step3: Create a new version or publish an existing draft

idle.title: You're all set
idle.body: No onboarding steps for you right now. The wizard will let you know when something needs attention.

createPlatformAdmin.title: Create a platform admin
createPlatformAdmin.body: Spin up the platform admin organization. This step ticks as soon as it exists.

inviteMember.title: Invite your first member
inviteMember.body: Add another person to your platform admin organization.

createLegalDocument.title: Create a legal document
createLegalDocument.body: Publish your platform's terms of service, privacy policy, or any other consent document so members can review and accept.

inviteEmployees.title: Invite your first employee
inviteEmployees.body: Add your team so they can access the platform.
